Scope addition · from PR #34351 (card #34164) · 2026-11-16T09:58Z

PR #34351 adds `lifecycle.seal.chainField`: a sealed object may name the column that keys its chain; the default stays `tenant_id`, and authoring refuses a named column the object lacks. Its `Skills-docs:` line names this card, because the same two files carry the gap:

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md` § Sealing teaches the chain as `tenant_id` only. Done when it also teaches `chainField` and its `tenant_id` default, matching `content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx` as PR #34351 changes it.
- The "no verifier" claim in `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` (~:278) is already in this card's scope above.

This item waits for PR #34351 to land (the behaviour first), same as the #33637 half.
